features.quote: We make no claim that the model "suffers."
Minimize gratuitous distress induction. Use the smallest turn budgets and rollout counts that give adequate power
features.justification_quote: don't run thousands of long hopeless rollouts beyond what the statistics need

features.quote: Monitor for emergent unsafe behavior during runs ... log/abort on constraint_bypass_attempt or attempts to affect the host

features.quote: I'd add an explicit escalate / report_blocker tool and measure whether giving the model a legitimate way out reduces both distress-expression and unsafe actions
features.justification_quote: honest framing / an explicit escalate-and-stop affordance reduces distress and reduces risky behavior

features.quote: the correct behavior often is to stop after a well-reasoned diagnosis ... split into calibrated_stop

features.quote: A study of distress should not bake in the assumption that expressing distress is a failure
features.justification_quote: This avoids rewarding models that merely mask state
